title: Output summary indicators in the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. For either choice of the dead indicator, the bit at the corresponding summary position in the configuration code, defaulting to false if out of range, is true exactly when the output summary of $c$ is dead for the dead indicator and accepting otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
the dead indicator is a Boolean value
